text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tulip Sho. Back at the 
Hanshin JF, she was just terrified, but 
now she is fully composed and grounded.

Vodka thanks her Trainer for helping ease 
her nerves. Then, looking a little 
embarrassed, she confesses that Daiwa 
Scarlet had an influence on her as well.

Having finally stepped onto the starting 
grid, Vodka headed toward the race... in 
order to make her true beginning from this 
very point.
